question: The perimeter of an isosceles triangle is 91 cm. If one of the equal sides measures 28 cm, then what is the value of the other non-equal side?
solution:
Given:

The perimeter of an isosceles triangle = 91 cm.

One of the equal sides measures 28 cm.

Concept used:

An isosceles triangle two angles will also be the same in front of the equal sides.

Formula used:

P = (2a + b)

Where, p = perimeter

a = side and b = another side

Calculation:

Let the length of the equal sides be x

P = (2a + b)

⇒ 91 = 2 × 28 + b

⇒ (91 – 56) = b

⇒ 35 = b

∴ The length of the non-equal side is 35 cm.

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
